summary: @servicetitan/anvil2-ext-charts preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated sibling payload
details: Package is published under the @servicetitan npm scope but ships a decoy library (dist/index.js is 82 bytes; author/description/license fields are empty) alongside an install-time dropper. The package.json declares scripts.preinstall="node setup.mjs". setup.mjs is itself identifier-obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style `_0xNNNN` names and per-function string-alias objects covering the Alpine/musl detection, HTTPS downloader, ZIP parser, and executor). When Bun is not already on PATH, setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases into a temp directory, marks it executable, and uses execFileSync to run the bundled sibling file math_init.js under Bun. math_init.js is a ~727KB single-line, string-array-rotation-obfuscated payload (header `// @bun @bun-cjs`, rotator function shifting a large mixed-literal array); its filename has no relation to the package's advertised charts purpose and it is not reachable from the Node-facing dist entry. Executing an obfuscated 727KB payload under a second runtime fetched at install time constitutes attacker-controlled code execution on the installer's machine on every `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
